signatureObjects.name: Four-Color Grid
signatureObjects.why: The book's central artifact — two axes making Red/Yellow/Green/Blue quadrants. No shared icon depicts a 2x2 behavior matrix; the film returns to it every beat.

signatureObjects.name: Stuart's Red/Green Office Lamp
signatureObjects.why: The red/green lamp above Stuart's office door the whole company checks before approaching — the most concrete image of Red terror ruling a workplace. No shared icon depicts a door signal lamp.

spine.claim: You are not surrounded by idiots — you assume your own brain is the default while everyone else thinks YOU are the idiot.
The four colors decoded — Red speed, Yellow energy, Green stability, Blue precision — each strength is another color's flaw.
Under stress the mask slips — the Red CEO slams the table, the Green withdraws, the Yellow deflects, the Blue freezes.
Reading people takes two minutes — pace, voice, posture, email style — and observation beats stereotyping.
Adaptation is translation not faking — same message in four colors, and the idiots disappear.
